## Design

### 2026-10-11 – I just figured out which components I wanted to use. I originally wanted to use this one:https://newhavendisplay.com/2-7-inch-white-graphic-oled-module/ for the screen because it was pretty big, but i

**2h**

I just figured out which components I wanted to use. I originally wanted to use this one:https://newhavendisplay.com/2-7-inch-white-graphic-oled-module/ for the screen because it was pretty big, but it was WAYYY over budget. So I decided to go with this one: https://seengreat.com/product/294/2-42-inch-oled-display-bw-a, a cheaper, smaller screen that I can even select different colors when I purchase.

For switches/ Buttons/ Joysticks I decided to just go with switches/ buttons and save me some time with coding. I was debating using some clicky buttons, but I felt they would be hard to press and become annoying after a while. So with switches in mind I was deciding which ones to use; especially coming in packs of 4 or something similar, and deciding on these ones: https://www.electromaker.io/shop/product/mx-silent-red-stem-full-travel-linear-feel-low-force-spring-red-stem-frame-mount. They were a little bit more marked up than the official retailer, but they let me select individual ones so I decided on those.

So the screen costs 12 bucks, and the switches cost 6 bucks , leaving about 12 bucks for the pcb, which seems pretty doable for a pcb of the size that I'm making.
